classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round every rank calls barrier.wait() then _read_staged on the same round's manifest and hits another barrier.wait() right after, so all ranks are held at the synchronisation point until that one file's open/fstat/pread completes, and each rank reads a given manifest file once.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: After the post-manifest barrier each rank synchronously _read()s its own sidecar(workdir, me, i) with no barrier in between, so only the reading rank waits, and the loop repeats for all cell.rounds=200 rounds on the same per-rank file.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Each rank blocks on _read() of its private shard(workdir, me, i) inside the unsynchronised tail of every round, so only that rank waits and each shard file is re-read once per each of the 200 rounds.
